[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]100 (Sandbox) |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (4.35) |spawned_by = [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Variable}} |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} ==Description== The '''Brick Man''' was an enemy spawned by the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] that only appeared in [[Headache Headquarters]], replacing the [[Skeleton]]. Currently, it only appears when the [[Brain Rot]] modifier is activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, replacing every modern [[Skeleton]] variant. It has a high amount of health, the same as the [[Png Bot2]] and an above average speed. It can also sometimes be [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]]. ==Appearance== The '''Brick Man''' is a plastic toy figure. It has yellow skin, a blue shirt and brown pants. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Headache Headquarters]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Golden Minigunner]] or [[Crook Boss]] can be very useful against this. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at boosting the firerate and range of these towers respectively. *Area of effect towers like the [[Rocketeer]], [[Mortar]], [[Pyromancer]] or [[Electroshocker]] are a good option against the '''Brick Man''', as multiple are spawned by the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]]. ==Sounds== {{Sounds| {{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" {{!}}- !
